description: Bilan Détaillé du PPI 2017/2026 - Chemin de Fer is a dataset listed in data.corsica open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Collectivité de Corse. Ce fichier présente le plan pluriannuel des investissements (PPI) ferroviaires de la Collectivité de Corse pour la période 2017–2026. Il recense les opérations relatives au réseau ferroviaire insulaire, notamment les travaux d’infrastructure, de modernisation, de sécurisation et de renouvellement du matériel roulant. Coverage: Corsica. The portal files it under Transport & Mobility. Its keywords are Infrastructures, routes, Plan pluriannuel des investissements (PPI), PPI. The portal shows 23 records. The portal shows 2025-08-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-corsica-portal.
